sources.title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_original: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

sources.title_original: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。

sources.summary: The Nasdaq 100 has slipped into a bear market after its worst weekly loss since the Covid-19 crisis. AI doubts, scandals, rising interest rates, and political headwinds are hitting overheated valuations all at once. The article US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 來自哥倫比亞大學與 CertiK 的 TensorLean，使用 Lean 在 PTX 層級對正式環境的 GPU 核心進行形式化驗證。它檢查了 149 個核心例項，證明瞭 83 個正確，並在 FlashAttention、DeepGEMM 等專案中發現了 38 個錯誤。

events.news_summary: Nvidia研究員稱大型AI上下文窗口是死衚衕，測試顯示定期摘要與關鍵字搜尋能以極低成本達到相近效果。

sources.title: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條 / Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條
sources.title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_original: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

primary_item.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

source_material.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
source_material.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title_en: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.title_original: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。

New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop

Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. featured_primary_item.title_en: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
featured_primary_item.title_original: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
featured_primary_item.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
featured_primary_item.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。
